rows.label: Jimmy Fallon
rows.description: American talk show host and comedian (born 1974)
rows.hook: took over NBC's late-night desk and became known for music, games and lip-sync battles

rows.label: Oprah Winfrey
rows.description: American talk show host, actress, producer, and author (born 1954)
rows.hook: became the Queen of All Media with a hugely popular conversation hour and a famous book club

rows.label: Jimmy Kimmel
rows.description: American talk show host and comedian (born 1967)
rows.hook: fronts a network program with celebrity pranks and has emceed the Oscars several times

rows.label: Jon Stewart
rows.description: American comedian, writer, producer, activist, and television host
rows.hook: led a satirical fake-news program on Comedy Central for sixteen seasons

rows.label: Whoopi Goldberg
rows.description: American actress, comedian, author and television personality
rows.hook: is one of the few entertainers to win an Emmy, Grammy, Oscar and Tony

rows.label: Stephen Colbert
rows.hook: played a fictional blowhard pundit on cable before taking over CBS's after-dark desk

rows.label: Johnny Carson
rows.description: American talk show host and comedian (1925–2005)
rows.hook: ruled late-night television for three decades with his monologues and couch chats

rows.label: Barbara Walters
rows.hook: was a trailblazing TV journalist famed for her celebrity interviews and for creating a daytime panel

rows.label: Jay Leno
rows.hook: took over NBC late night from Carson and is a famous car collector

rows.label: David Letterman
rows.hook: was famed for his Top Ten lists, a gap-toothed grin and tossing things off his desk

rows.label: Trevor Noah
rows.description: South African comedian and television host
rows.hook: is a South African comedian who succeeded Jon Stewart at Comedy Central's satirical news desk

rows.label: Seth Meyers
rows.description: American comedian, television host and actor
rows.hook: anchored the Weekend Update fake-news desk on SNL before hosting his own NBC program

rows.label: James Corden
rows.description: English actor, comedian, singer and television host (born 1978)
rows.hook: is an English comedian famous for his Carpool Karaoke segments and the sitcom Gavin & Stacey

rows.label: Craig Ferguson
rows.hook: is a Scottish-born host who chatted with a skeleton robot sidekick and won a Peabody

rows.label: John Oliver
rows.hook: is a British comedian who delivers long HBO rants on a weekly news-comedy program

rows.label: Steve Allen
rows.description: American actor, comedian, musician and presenter (1921–2000)

rows.label: Jack Paar
rows.description: American author, radio and television comedian and talk show host (1918-2004)
